Subject: 
Special Called Meeting
Per Article II, Section 10 of the City Charter, this will serve as my written request for a
Special Called Meeting of the Austin City Council to be held on Wednesday, November
17, 2010, at 9:30 a.m. at Austin City Hall, Boards and Commissions, for a briefing on the
Downtown Plan.
